map.：输入：咬肌肌电峰值 EMG=450μV，磨牙事件 40 次/夜，单次持续 8s:
: input: peak masseter EMG=450μV, 40 bruxism events per night, 8s each
estimate: peak bite force ≈ k·EMG (empirical coefficient), cumulative load = peak x single-event duration x event count
note: a marked overload suggests an occlusal splint and a follow-up assessment.
